text:
[Council File 26-0088-S2]
City Attorney reports and draft Ordinances relative to making technical amendments to the legal requirements of covenants required by the United to House LA Program and exempting certain conveyances of real property from the Measure ULA tax.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Housing Committee action: Approved: Approved City Attorney reports dated October 6, 2026 and October 14, 2026, and Adopted the draft Ordinances dated October 6, 2026 and October 13, 2026 (Nov 5, 2026)
